column3: The Hebrew coordinates “these acts and faithfulness”; BSB says “these acts of faithfulness.”
The Hebrew says his face was toward war against Jerusalem; BSB says he had come to make war against it.
The Hebrew leaves the subject unnamed here and calls the structure the Millo; BSB names Hezekiah and says “supporting terraces.”
The Hebrew leaves the subject unnamed here and says he spoke to their heart; BSB names Hezekiah and says he encouraged them.
The Hebrew says the people leaned on his words; BSB says they were strengthened by them.
The Hebrew says “his servants”; BSB specifies “the servants of Sennacherib.”
The Hebrew leaves the plural speakers unnamed and calls the language Judean; BSB names the Assyrians and calls the language Hebrew.
The Hebrew separately says that they prayed and cried out to heaven; BSB combines these as “cried out to heaven in prayer.”
The Hebrew says “house of his god” and describes his killers as those who came from his inward parts; BSB says “temple of his god” and “his own sons.”
The Hebrew says He led them on every side; BSB says He gave them rest on every side.
The Hebrew says his heart was lifted up; BSB expresses this as pride.
